rules.description: De‑duplicated applications must be grouped according to their respective schemes.
rules.evidence_quote: All the de-duplicated applications will be bundled as per their schemes.

rules.description: NIC must create a scheme‑wise report and distribute it to all relevant Ministries/Departments.
rules.outcome: NIC prepares the report and shares it with each Ministry/Department
rules.evidence_quote: A scheme-wise report will be prepared by NIC and shared with all the respective Ministries / Departments at this stage.

rules.description: Each Ministry/Department must provide its merit‑list generation methodology to NIC.
rules.condition: When NIC has shared the scheme‑wise report with the Ministries/Departments
rules.outcome: The Ministry/Department shares its methodology for merit list generation with NIC
rules.evidence_quote: Each Ministry / Department will share their methodology for merit list generation, with NIC.

rules.description: Each Ministry/Department must form a team that includes at least one Program Division officer and one NIC official attached to that Ministry/Department.
rules.condition: To facilitate the merit‑list preparation process
rules.outcome: A team is constituted with the specified minimum composition
rules.evidence_quote: each Ministry/Department will constitute a team comprising of at least one officer from concerned Program Division and one NIC official attached with the concerned Ministry / Department.
